images.name: in-3-weeks
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, arms crossed, beside a stethoscope under the word "DIAGNOSIS:". A notepad reads: "In 3 weeks: His FTP went up 10%, basically because he started eating to fuel performance instead of weighing a certain amount. If he tried to get to the same w/kg by dieting, he would have had to lose almost Nine pounds assuming he could have held the same power in his previous test."
images.note: The stethoscope earpieces hung around the old cartoon's neck; they go with him. The tube and chest piece on the right stay.
